/* Fixed overlays that assumed the floating toolbar: anchor them to the stage
   column instead of the viewport corners so nothing lands on the sidebars. */
.app-root:has(.rs-root) .path-panel { top: calc(var(--rs-top) + 16px); left: calc(var(--rs-left) + 16px); }
/* The digest is a passive notice on the stage: it sits under the top bar's
   stacking context (z-overlay) so the More-tools menu, the Export view and
   anything else the user opens stacks above it, while it still clears the
   canvas and the side columns (z 2). */
.app-root:has(.rs-root) .insights-digest-layer { top: calc(var(--rs-top) + 16px); left: calc(var(--rs-left) + 16px); z-index: calc(var(--z-overlay) - 1); }
.app-root:has(.rs-root) .insights-layer { padding-top: var(--rs-top); }
/* The welcome card sits under the top bar instead of across it. */
.app-root:has(.rs-root) .empty-state-layer { top: var(--rs-top); }
/* The card's own max-height counts the whole viewport, so a tall card was
   centred past the layer's top edge and covered the tabs on phones. */
.app-root:has(.rs-root) .empty-state__card { max-height: calc(100dvh - var(--rs-top) - 48px); }
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .app-root:has(.rs-root) .empty-state__card { max-height: calc(100dvh - var(--rs-top) - 20px); }
}
/* The strip already spans just the stage column (the minimap and chat
   launcher sit outside it), so the classic 88px/256px insets only squeezed
   the card until the phase title truncated to "Embedd…". */
.app-root:has(.rs-root) .progress-strip-layer { left: var(--rs-left); right: var(--rs-right); padding-inline: 16px; }
.app-root:has(.rs-root) .first-run-guide { right: calc(var(--rs-right) + 18px); }

/* Modals and dialogs (Settings, Snapshots, Help, Insights, the corpus menu
   and the import/share/Rekordbox confirms) take the Resonance palette the
   same way the full-details panel does: the legacy theme variables are
   re-pointed, so the surface becomes the solid raised tone (nothing bleeds
   through), dividers use the panel line colour and the accent is lime. The
   confirms are portaled to <body>, hence the body-level selector. */
.app-root:has(.rs-root) :is(.settings-panel, .snapshot-drawer, .help-popover, .insights, .corpus-switcher__menu),
body:has(.rs-root) .confirm-dialog {
  --bg-glass: var(--rs-raised);
  --bg-glass-strong: var(--rs-raised);
  --bg-glass-soft: var(--rs-panel);
  --panel-bg: var(--rs-raised);
  --surface: var(--rs-raised);
  --surface-raised: var(--rs-raised);
  --surface-inset: var(--rs-bg);
  --border-glass: var(--rs-line);
  --border-glass-strong: var(--rs-line-strong);
  --text-primary: var(--rs-text);
  --text-secondary: var(--rs-muted);
  --text-faint: var(--rs-faint);
  --text: var(--rs-text);
  --text-muted: var(--rs-muted);
  --accent: var(--rs-lime);
  --accent-strong: var(--rs-lime);
  --accent-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rs-lime) 14%, transparent);
  --accent-fill: var(--rs-lime);
  --accent-fill-hover: #d6ff7a;
  --accent-foreground: var(--rs-lime-ink);
  --control-hover: var(--rs-line);
  --focus: var(--rs-lime);
  background: var(--rs-raised);
  border-color: var(--rs-line-strong);
  backdrop-filter: none; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 40px #0009;
}

/* Inputs sit on the darker base tone so they read as fields on the card. */
